Hi Maria / Acme team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — we’re excited to get Acme set up so Redwood can start routing POs and invoices. To speed things up for finance and procurement, could you complete the attached supplier identity sheet and return it with a completed W-9 (or local tax form if applicable)? Key fields we need:

- Legal entity name (exact, as registered)
- Tax ID / VAT number
- Billing / remit address (street, city, state, postal code, country)
- Primary invoicing email and PO acceptance email
- ACH details or preferred wire instructions (bank name, account name, account number, routing / IBAN)
- Contact name and phone for invoice/PO escalations

We also need confirmation whether Acme requires PO numbers on invoices and whether you accept emailed invoices or prefer upload to our supplier portal.

Attached is our supplier_identity_sheet.xlsx for your convenience. If you prefer, you can reply inline with the details. Once we have these, Marissa will create the supplier record and route a verification to Finance for banking verification.

Timeline request: would you be able to return the sheet + W-9 by end of week (Friday 12/18)? If not, let us know a quick ETA.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
